criteria.requirement: Implement csvkit.headers.rename_columns(names,mapping,*,collision="error") and actual CSVCut --rename-columns-json / --rename-collision=error|suffix. Validate exact unique original source names, nonempty string targets and unknown mappings, apply against the full original header before projecting originally selected columns and change no cell values. Reject collisions by default; suffix mode preserves first occurrence and avoids all reserved eventual target names. Reject headerless rename before output, invalid JSON/shapes and ambiguous duplicate source names. Keep old cut/default headers, order and mapping inputs unchanged.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
